name: toolkit
description: General-purpose skills any team or app can use: watch a video in detail (frames plus transcript), find and install skills from the open skills ecosystem, caveman voice for terse replies, browser automation via agent-browser (Chrome-based), headless browser automation via obscura (no Chrome needed), and decide, which weighs a choice the way the project's owner does, from principles and overrides the project keeps. Third-party skills are kept unmodified apart from a Source section.
